title: electronic warning and status signal hardware

specimens.name: Red xenon strobe beacon
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Compact red ribbed xenon strobe dome on a low standardized metal/polymer base; off, no active flash or glow. This is a strobe-only hardware example, not a caged incandescent rotating beacon, horn, siren, speaker, operator instrument or status tower.

specimens.name: Amber xenon strobe beacon
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Matching compact AMBER ribbed xenon strobe dome and the exact same low industrial base geometry as specimen 01; off. Not a red/green paired panel, stack light, speaker or analog control.

specimens.name: Clear xenon strobe beacon
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Matching compact CLEAR/NEUTRAL ribbed xenon strobe dome and the exact same low base geometry as specimens 01–02; off, empty-looking clear lens without emitted light. Not a tri-color stack, megaphone, horn or lamp.

specimens.name: Modular three-color stack light
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE compact three-tier cylindrical stack-light module in strict order red over amber over green, short gray standardized base, visibly smaller standardized late-1990s segments; all off. Not a horn, loudspeaker, grille, enclosure or alarm siren.

specimens.name: Sealed wedge-shaped amber directional LED hazard marker
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One low-profile triangular/wedge-shaped industrial AMBER directional warning emitter, with a visibly angled faceted optical face and shallow metal/polymer housing on one compact physical mount; tightly organized early LED lenses under a sealed passive window, all unlit. This is a directional hazard-marker head, NOT the paired red/amber flat status modules or a work lamp from E2/lighting-signals/01. No arrow shape, text, cabling, installed track or runway.

specimens.name: Bistable electromechanical fault-flag indicator cartridge
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One compact late-1990s fail-safe status-flag cartridge: a precision beige/gray metal housing containing a small stationary two-face red/neutral flip-flag behind a plain clear window, with a visible compact protected electromagnetic actuator housing and one local pivot. No LED lens, lamp, green indicator, operator switch, label, text, wiring, moving/blurred state or complete console. Physical warning-state indicator only, not an old hand-operated semaphore.

specimens.name: Red multi-LED array signal module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE compact rectangular RED multi-LED signal module with a regular grid of many small unlit physical LED lenses behind a clear passive cover, bounded by one shallow housing; no symbols. Not toggle switches, levers, analog gauges or pushbuttons.

specimens.name: Annular amber multi-LED obstruction-marker head
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One shallow round industrial annular obstruction-marker emitter module with a complete circular ring of many small amber physical LED lenses behind a single weather-sealed transparent annular cover, in a compact machined gray housing with short mounting lug; all off. Circular annulus, not the flat RECTANGULAR red LED grid of specimen 07, not another paired warning strip or conventional beacon dome. No text, arrows or projected light.

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, arrows, symbols, logos or pseudo-writing
complete beacon towers, runway assemblies, vehicle lighting systems, warning panels, buildings, rooms or scenes
any ninth or extra specimen, duplicate specimen, omitted specimen, merged specimen or substitution
wiring, control panels, screens, complete machines or architecture
motor-driven E1 rotating beacon mechanisms as the dominant signal language, prismatic passive reflectors as major specimens or large sealed floodlights
active light, flashing state, glow, bloom, rays, projected light pools or baked cast/contact shadows
decorative LED strips, modern matrix message boards or E3/E4 architectural lighting
photorealistic product photography, filtered 3D rendering or soft studio lighting
all megaphones, loudspeakers, horns, sirens, alarm-speaker grilles and caged rotating incandescent beacons; these are not substitutes for any specified cell
all analog dial gauges, rotary controls, toggle switches, lever switches, relay/coil enclosures, exposed wired terminal strips, pushbutton control panels or icon-bearing status panels
active-looking glowing red, amber or green lenses, flash-tube emissions, luminous inner bulbs or colored light spills; physical lens coloration alone is allowed
flat grouped red/amber LED status bars or standard green hooded panel indicators already covered by E2/lighting-signals/01; duplicate rectangular amber matrix matching specimen 07 except color

era_contract.character: late-1990s electronic warning/status language replacing E1 motor-driven beacon emphasis with compact xenon strobe families, smaller modular three-tier stack hardware, electronic directionally shielded LED warning emitters and a physically distinct bistable fail-safe status flag; every specimen class must be distinguishable in geometry/function
required_signals: distinct shallow wedge-shaped directional amber LED warning marker
bistable physical fault flag with protected electromagnetic drive, not an operator switch
separate annular amber LED obstruction-marker head
replaced_previous_language: E1 motor-driven rotating warning beacons as the dominant warning technology
larger discrete warning lamps and sealed flood/work lights as primary signal hardware
forbidden_regressions: operator controls, analog dials and acoustic horn/speaker hardware substituted for signal specimens
multiple flat LED status bars or ordinary green hooded pilot lights already represented on sheet E2/lighting-signals/01
